radius.$description: Radii in rem: they grow with the text size, like the spacing (at a 13 px root: inline 3.25 px, control 8.45 px, tile 5.85 px, panel and message 11.7 px). D2: control, panel and message are softer (was 6.5 / 9.75 / 9.75 px).

tile.$description: A chat tile in the sidebar (D2): a 22.75 px square with soft corners.

control.$description: Buttons, input fields, a chat row, a menu item, a code block inside a plate.

panel.$description: The composer, a toast, the context menu, a dialog.

message.$description: A message plate and the 'On this day' card.

floating.$description: The floating quick capture panel (a 'pill'): 19.5 px at a 13 px root, as in Gemini and ChatGPT (the reference is 18-22 px).

round.$description: Fully rounded elements: the day label.
